relations.text_en: Agreed to buy it in January 2026

source.label: VSE Corporation 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: PAG Acquisition On January 29, 2026, the Company entered into a stock purchase agreement (the "Purchase Agreement") to acquire Precision Aviation Group ("PAG"), a portfolio company of GenNx360 Capital Partners, for total upfront consideration of approximately $2.025 billion in cash and equity (the "PAG Acquisition").
